short: Zn2+ Induced Phase Transformation of K2MnFe(CN)6 Boosts High
title: Zn2+ Induced Phase Transformation of K2MnFe(CN)6 Boosts Highly Stable Zinc-Ion Storage

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Zinc-ion batteries need cathodes holding a high, stable capacity at high voltage over hundreds of cycles. Co-inserted Zn2+ should convert K2MnFe(CN)6 into a framework that hosts divalent Zn2+ stably.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/route), n5 (PRC/synthesis), n7 (PRC/stimulus)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: As-prepared KMnHCF is monoclinic P21/n, a 3D open framework of N-coordinated Mn and C-coordinated Fe. Zn2+ becomes the dominant inserted cation, near 50 at% of the cathode metals from the 20th cycle.
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (STR/phase/identity), n8a (STR/chemistry/composition), n8b (STR/chemistry/composition), n9 (STR/phase/identity), n10 (STR/phase/site_occupancy). Premises: Earlier reports show Zn2+ switching between cavity sites and vacant Fe(CN)6 sites in PBAs

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Zn2+ relieves the electronic degeneracy and drives an intense Jahn-Teller distortion that breaks the MnN6 framework. Zn2+ raises Coulomb attraction and weakens d-pi covalency, tipping the balance to the rhombohedral phase.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (MEC/pathway), n12 (MEC/tradeoff), n15 (MEC/pathway), n16 (PRP/behavior_class), n17 (MEC/identification), n18 (PRP/value), n25 (PRP/value). Premises: Degenerate electronic states destabilise an atomic configuration; Jahn-Teller distortion relieves the degeneracy; Henkelman's theory: PBA phase stability is set by competing Coulomb attraction, d-pi covalency and Pauli repulsion

states.title: Performance state
states.head: 98% capacity retention from the 100th to the 400th cycle at 0.2 A/g with 99-100% coulombic efficiency

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Zn2+-induced conversion of KMnHCF into KZnHCF yields a stable high-voltage zinc-ion cathode
